articles.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
articles.snippet: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

articles.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
articles.snippet: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

articles.title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
articles.snippet: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.

articles.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK buys the dip on Robinhood in its largest purchase in 6 months after 23% slump
articles.snippet: HOOD fell 3.3% on Wednesday, broadening its one-month decline to more than 23%.

articles.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
articles.snippet: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.
